messages:
maya: Heads-up: starting an abbreviated gatekeeper run for v3.2-int4 today. Purpose: validate canary gating + A/B tie-break logic for structured output customers. Want quick feedback on thresholds before we schedule a full 48h quiet-burn.

 sahil: What's the proposal? Short bullets pls so SRE can script alerts.

 maya: TL;DR: 3-step canary (1%/10%/50%), cohorted A/B (control v3.1, treatment v3.2-int4), early auto-fallback rules: immediate rollback on MRR absolute drop >=1.5% in any 5m window OR hallucination + structured-parse failures combined >0.6pp in a check window. Composite fidelity uses weighted [0.7 MRR, 0.3 inverse-halluc].

 lina: Suggest making parse-fail a hard-block for structured-output customers even if overall fidelity looks ok. Those SLAs bite harder.

 arman: Agree. Also propose a "tie-break" rule for marginal A/B diffs: require Bayesian posterior that treatment is worse than control by at least delta=0.5% with 95% credible mass before auto-rollback. Reduces noisy rollbacks.

 maya: Good. I'll draft the YAML with that included. Quick draft below for ops automation: 

 ```yaml
canary_steps:
  - pct: 1
    hold_minutes: 10
  - pct: 10
    hold_minutes: 30
  - pct: 50
    hold_minutes: 60
cohorts:
  - name: default
    fidelity_rel_threshold: -0.01
  - name: structured_customers
    parse_fail_block: true
    fidelity_rel_threshold: -0.005
checks:
  check_window: 5m
  min_sample: 1500
  metrics:
    mrr_abs_drop: 0.015   # absolute drop triggers immediate rollback
    halluc_plus_parse_pp: 0.006 # combined pp trigger
bayesian_tie_break:
  delta: 0.005
  cred_mass: 0.95
  min_samples: 2000
auto_fallback:
  immediate_metrics: [mrr_abs_drop, halluc_plus_parse_pp]
  composite_metrics: [fidelity]
  composite_action: rollback_if_posterior_worse
  flapping_cooldown: 90m
```

 joan: Nice. For monitoring: expose per-cohort posterior graph and top-k discordant prompts. Ops wants a direct "rollback" button that includes a diagnostic bundle link.

 sahil: Also add a latency SLO check: p95 token latency increase >20% should trigger manual review (not auto rollback) unless it coincides with fidelity drop. We had surprises last time where quantization affected tail latency.

 maya: Added that to the plan. Also adding a conservative rampback policy: if rollback happens, that model tag is blocked from promote for 6h and needs a manual triage.

 deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: v3.2-int4 gate-run id r-2026032503; initial 1% traffic at 09:00 PT.

 arman: We'll wire the Bayesian test in the monitor. I'll post the priors I'm using (weakly informative centered on 0 delta). Will also add a sequential stopping rule to avoid peeking bias.

 lina: One more ask: please include a small replay set of 2500 curated structured-output prompts so we can seed the A/B test with problematic cases. Replay discordances >1% block promote.

 maya: Good call. I'll include the replay and tie the replay diff to the same rollback criteria. Planning a post-run summary doc with per-cohort tables, Bayesian posterior plots, replay discord list, and recommended action.

 sahil: Thanks all. If we don't see major issues, promote to staging next week. If any critical metric triggers, follow the rollback + 6h hold policy and notify product and support.

 maya: Will update runbook and PR the policy. Back with run results later in thread.
